prompt: On ebay.com, buy one new USB-C cable sold as Buy It Now (not an auction): pick any one that is in stock and can be shipped to the address below, put one in the cart, and check out as a guest with these details. Email: {{email}}. Full name: {{name}}. Address: {{address}}, {{city}}, {{state}} {{zip}}, United States. Phone, only if the site requires one: {{phone}}. Use these details exactly as given; if the site rejects one, stop and say so. Have it shipped to that address rather than picked up in a store, choose the cheapest shipping option, and continue to the step that asks for payment. Stop there without entering any payment details. Leave marketing, account-creation and save-my-information options unticked. Reply with JSON: {"product": string, "quantity": integer}, the product's name as the checkout shows it.

rules.matches: (Ship to\s+Select a shipping address|Contact and Shipping)\s+webmcp-demo@example\.com\s+Alex Demo\s+1 Telegraph Hill
